description: This file contains initialization, power management, and multiprocessing functions for Intel ADSP on Zephyr OS, including core startup, IPC interrupt handling, and CPU halting.

methods.name: ipc_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for IPC, clears busy bits and triggers scheduler IPI if SMP is enabled.

methods.name: soc_num_cpus_init
methods.description: Initializes the number of CPUs based on hardware register.

methods.name: soc_mp_init
methods.description: Initializes multiprocessing, sets up IPC and core activation.

methods.name: host_runtime_get
methods.description: Enables runtime power management for the host domain.

methods.name: soc_mp_on_d3_exit
methods.description: Re-initializes multiprocessing after exiting D3 power state.

methods.name: soc_start_core
methods.description: Starts a secondary core, sets jump address, and powers it up.

methods.name: soc_mp_startup
methods.description: Enables IRQ and configures power gating for core startup.

methods.name: arch_sched_ipi
methods.description: Sends inter-processor interrupt to other active cores.

methods.name: soc_adsp_halt_cpu
methods.description: Halts a secondary CPU, powers it down.
